about.title: About OBAI
about.standfirst: Oceania Business Association Incorporated is a Melbourne-based, not-for-profit membership association.
about.introTitle: Based in Melbourne, connecting China, Australia and Oceania
about.introBody1: Oceania Business Association (OBAI) was founded in Melbourne as a not-for-profit membership association, with offices and service networks across Oceania, promoting trade cooperation, industry exchange and investment across China, Australia and the Asia-Pacific.
about.introBody2: The association's work rests on its government and business network, its industry chapters and the ABS one-stop market-entry services, organised around four practice pillars that support members' cross-border growth.
about.pillarsStandfirst: How the vision is delivered — the association's four core lines of work.
about.structureText: The association's structure comprises its leadership and honorary advisers, the China Enterprise Going-Global Strategy Committee, the industry chapters and a professional secretariat.
about.galleryStandfirst: Photographs from events and trade exchanges the association has already published.

apply.title: Join OBAI
apply.standfirst: Submit your application online; after review, the secretariat will email payment instructions.
apply.step1Text: Complete the online form, choose a membership tier and upload supporting documents.
apply.step3Text: Once approved, the secretariat emails official payment instructions.
apply.step4Text: After payment your membership is activated, and your company is listed in the directory subject to your consent.
apply.feeValidity: Membership is valid for one year from the date of payment.
